subject: Executive bridge: confirming CTO/CIO sponsor attendance and time tethering
messages:
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@orintech.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@orintech.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: brief exec intro + demo — CT O & VP presence?

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — it went well internally and our platform team is excited to take a closer look. Christine (our CIO) and our CTO candidate, Marcus, would like a short executive-level walkthrough focused on production guarantees, SLA behavior, and how Redwood would slot into our multi-region architecture. We expect this to be a 30–45 minute session: 15 minutes for exec-level talk and 20–30 for a concise product run-through and Q&A.

Would you be able to hold a slot next week where both our CIO and CTO can attend? If possible, we’d like one of your SVP/Head-of-Product or an engineering sponsor who can speak to dedicated capacity and private deployment options.

Top priorities for us:
- SLA commitments and regional failover behavior
- Data residency and private deployment checklist
- Typical coverage model for CIO/CTO attendance (who do we expect to see at what stage)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 12/8: 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed 12/9: 10:00–10:45 or 16:00–16:45

Thanks — Sam
Sam Peterson
Head of Platform Strategy, OrinTech
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@orintech.com>
Cc: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@orintech.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: brief exec intro + demo — CT O & VP presence?

Sam — great to hear the team is engaged. Rafael and Neha from our product and solutions side are looped in; Rafael can cover Dedicated/Private deployment guarantees and Neha will handle SSO/KMS and compliance questions.

Quick notes before we lock a time:
- For the executive portion, Rafael (VP, Product) will be the sponsor; he can speak to SLA targets and routing/fallback policies. If you need someone from engineering, I can bring our Head of Serving Runtime as backup (Tessa Morgan).
- We can compress to a 40-minute format: 10 min exec remarks, 25 min demo with 5 min rapid next steps. I’ll attach a short agenda.

I see Wed 12/9 16:00–16:45 PST looks like the best fit for everyone on our side. Can you confirm that both the CIO and CTO are available for that window? If Christine can’t make the 16:00 slot she can do Tue 12/8 09:30.

If you confirm, I’ll send the calendar invite with an agenda and a brief runbook. Also let me know if Marcus (CTO) prefers technical deep-dive artifacts in advance — we can include a one-page latency/cost summary and our SSO checklist.

Thanks,

Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-45m.pdf (agenda — 1 page)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@orintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 07:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: brief exec intro + demo — CT O & VP presence?

Adding a couple items for the exec block:
- I’ll open with a 8–10 minute top-line: how Redwood guarantees latency and handles failovers across regions; a short note on cost controls (Optimize features).
- For the demo, we’ll show a 14-minute run through: hosted API happy path, then a quick switch to Dedicated with a note on autoscaling/burst behavior.

Maya — Tessa is available on 12/9 at 16:00 PST as backup engineering witness. If Christine (CIO) needs to delegate, Rafael suggests including a VP-level backup rather than just a solutions engineer; calls out continuity when questions turn to procurement/SLA language.

Sam — could you confirm the attendee list and whether Christine will need us to cover procurement and contract cadence (we can keep that to a short slide at the end)? Also, if Marcus wants an SLO/operational playbook in advance we’ll share a one-pager.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: orintech-sso-checklist.xlsx (SSO + KMS fields)

Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: brief exec intro + demo — CT O & VP presence? — confirmed 12/9 16:00 PST

Thanks for confirming, Sam — calendar invite is sent (see link below). Quick summary for the session on Wed 12/9, 16:00–16:40 PST (40 minutes):

Agenda (attached):
- 0:00–0:08: Executive intro (Rafael Mendes) — SLA/failover philosophy and coverage model
- 0:08–0:33: Product run-through (Maya/Tessa) — hosted -> dedicated switch, autoscale, latency knobs
- 0:33–0:38: Procurement & rollout cadence (Neha) — contracts, reserved capacity options, SLAs
- 0:38–0:40: Next steps / scheduling deeper tech follow-up (all)

Logistics & asks:
- Please join via the calendar invite link. If Christine or Marcus need to dial in from EMEA, note the invite has automatic timezone conversion.
- Marcus: I attached the one-page latency/cost summary and the SSO checklist per Rafael’s note — do you want those ahead of the call? I can email a separate packet to Marcus directly.
- Delegate plan: if Christine needs to hand off, a VP-level backup is preferred so we can cover procurement language.

Links:
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite
- Demo runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/demo-runbook

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
